panel.label: Experimental
panel.name: experimental
panel.text: Experimental and diagnostic settings. Some changes require a viewer restart.

panel.name: experimental_general_settings

check_box.label: Only connect to adjacent regions
check_box.name: render_neighbor_adjacent_only
check_box.tool_tip: Only connect to the current and adjacent regions, plus the teleport target, to limit neighbor loading

check_box.label: Release regions that are no longer adjacent (experimental)
check_box.name: release_non_adjacent_regions
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Releases a neighbor region once it has been non-adjacent for 5 seconds, by closing that region's connection only. Requires 'Only connect to adjacent regions'. Logged under FSRegionRelease.

check_box.label: Fetch offline messages while online
check_box.name: fetch_offline_ims
check_box.tool_tip: Periodically request offline instant messages while online

check_box.label: Render alpha-blended objects into shadow maps
check_box.name: render_alpha_blend_shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Render alpha-blended objects into shadow maps; animated transparent effects may be expensive shadow casters

check_box.label: Use opaque depth for the RLVa debug sphere
check_box.name: rlva_debug_sphere_opaque_depth
check_box.tool_tip: Use a pre-alpha depth snapshot so alpha wearables do not punch through the RLVa sphere effect

check_box.label: Log texture fetch pipeline diagnostics
check_box.name: texture_fetch_pipeline_diagnostics
check_box.tool_tip: Periodically log a texture HTTP pipeline snapshot for diagnosing stalled texture fetches

check_box.label: Protect privacy while RLVa attachments load
check_box.name: rlva_experimental_login_privacy
check_box.tool_tip: Temporarily hide the world, names, location, maps, and nearby avatars during login; restrictions not resent by attachments are released after loading or a safety timeout

text.name: shadow_max_distance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far sun and moon shadows reach. The shadow maps are spread over this distance, so a shorter one makes nearby shadows much sharper, at the cost of no shadows further away. Reflection probes keep the full distance.

spinner.name: shadow_max_distance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far sun and moon shadows reach. The shadow maps are spread over this distance, so a shorter one makes nearby shadows much sharper, at the cost of no shadows further away. Reflection probes keep the full distance.

check_box.label: Use the video memory the driver reports for the texture budget
check_box.name: use_live_vram
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. On NVIDIA and AMD, textures are reduced when the GPU itself is running out of video memory, counting everything else using it, instead of using a fixed share of it. Has no effect when the texture memory limit is set manually.

text.name: texture_bias_soft_zone_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far below the texture memory target textures start being reduced, a little at a time, so memory levels off before it runs out instead of dropping detail all at once. 0.1 starts at 90% of the target. 0 waits until the target is reached.

panel.text: Start reducing textures before memory is full

spinner.name: texture_bias_soft_zone
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far below the texture memory target textures start being reduced, a little at a time, so memory levels off before it runs out instead of dropping detail all at once. 0.1 starts at 90% of the target. 0 waits until the target is reached.

check_box.label: Retry sooner for avatars stuck as a cloud
check_box.name: avatar_cloud_fast_retry
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When another avatar is missing its shape or body textures, ask the region for its appearance again after 15, 30 and 60 seconds, instead of only every 2 minutes.

check_box.label: Ask again when an avatar's appearance arrives without a shape
check_box.name: avatar_retry_empty_appearance
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When the region sends another avatar's appearance without a shape, ask for it again right away (at most every 10 seconds) instead of waiting for the cloud timeout.

check_box.label: Ignore out of order appearance updates
check_box.name: avatar_drop_stale_appearance
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. During an outfit change, appearance updates for another avatar can arrive out of order. Ignore one that is older than the last applied, if it arrives within 10 seconds of it. Logged under Avatar.

text.name: resolution_multiplier_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Renders the scene at this multiple of the window size and filters it down: above 1 smooths edges and fine detail (2 is the cleanest), below 1 renders faster at lower resolution. Above 1 costs a lot of GPU time and memory, and sun shadow maps grow with it. Ignored while the resolution divisor debug setting is above 1.

spinner.name: resolution_multiplier
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Renders the scene at this multiple of the window size and filters it down: above 1 smooths edges and fine detail (2 is the cleanest), below 1 renders faster at lower resolution. Above 1 costs a lot of GPU time and memory, and sun shadow maps grow with it. Ignored while the resolution divisor debug setting is above 1.

check_box.label: Snapshots wait for textures to finish loading
check_box.name: snapshot_wait_for_textures
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Before the snapshot floater captures, wait until the textures on screen have loaded at the resolution the picture needs. Snapshots larger than the window ask for sharper textures than the screen does.

text.name: snapshot_texture_wait_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Longest time a snapshot waits for textures before capturing anyway.

spinner.name: snapshot_texture_wait
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Longest time a snapshot waits for textures before capturing anyway.

check_box.label: Screen space reflections
check_box.name: ssr_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Reflect what is on screen in shiny surfaces, on top of the reflection probes.

text.name: ssr_iterations_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many steps each reflection ray takes looking for what it hits. More steps find more of the scene and further away. Default 25.

spinner.name: ssr_iterations
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many steps each reflection ray takes looking for what it hits. More steps find more of the scene and further away. Default 25.

text.name: ssr_ray_step_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Length of the first reflection ray step. Smaller steps give more precise reflections close to the surface but reach less far for the same number of steps. Default 0.1.

spinner.name: ssr_ray_step
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Length of the first reflection ray step. Smaller steps give more precise reflections close to the surface but reach less far for the same number of steps. Default 0.1.

text.name: ssr_glossy_samples_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Rays traced per pixel for reflections on rough surfaces. More rays give smoother, less noisy glossy reflections. Default 4.

spinner.name: ssr_glossy_samples
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Rays traced per pixel for reflections on rough surfaces. More rays give smoother, less noisy glossy reflections. Default 4.

text.name: ssr_distance_bias_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How close a ray has to come to a surface to count as hitting it. Larger values fill in gaps in reflections but can smear them. Default 0.015.

spinner.name: ssr_distance_bias
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How close a ray has to come to a surface to count as hitting it. Larger values fill in gaps in reflections but can smear them. Default 0.015.

text.name: ssr_reject_bias_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Depth difference below which a reflection hit is thrown away as the surface reflecting itself. Raise it if reflections show speckles on flat surfaces. Default 0.001.

spinner.name: ssr_reject_bias
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Depth difference below which a reflection hit is thrown away as the surface reflecting itself. Raise it if reflections show speckles on flat surfaces. Default 0.001.

check_box.label: Sun rays (light shafts)
check_box.name: sun_rays
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Light scattered in the air, broken into shafts wherever something casts a sun shadow: through trees, windows, gaps in buildings. Needs sun shadows on. The sun shadow distance setting limits how far they reach.

text.name: sun_rays_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the sun rays.

spinner.name: sun_rays_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the sun rays.

text.name: sun_rays_density_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the air scatters light. Higher values give thicker, hazier rays.

spinner.name: sun_rays_density
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the air scatters light. Higher values give thicker, hazier rays.

text.name: sun_rays_anisotropy_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 scatters light evenly in every direction. Higher values concentrate the rays around the sun, the way haze looks when facing the light.

spinner.name: sun_rays_anisotropy
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 scatters light evenly in every direction. Higher values concentrate the rays around the sun, the way haze looks when facing the light.

text.name: sun_rays_steps_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Samples taken along each ray. More gives cleaner shafts with less banding, at more GPU time.

spinner.name: sun_rays_steps
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Samples taken along each ray. More gives cleaner shafts with less banding, at more GPU time.

text.name: sun_rays_distance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far from the camera the air is lit.

spinner.name: sun_rays_distance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far from the camera the air is lit.

text.name: sun_rays_resolution_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution the rays are computed at. 0.5 is a quarter of the pixels and looks nearly the same, since the rays are soft.

spinner.name: sun_rays_resolution
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution the rays are computed at. 0.5 is a quarter of the pixels and looks nearly the same, since the rays are soft.

check_box.label: HDR bloom
check_box.name: bloom
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Bright parts of the image glow onto their surroundings: sun on water, lamps, emissive surfaces. Works from the full brightness range of the scene, separately from the classic glow.

text.name: bloom_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much bloom is added.

spinner.name: bloom_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much bloom is added.

text.name: bloom_threshold_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness above which light blooms. 1 is full white on screen, lower values let more of the image bloom.

spinner.name: bloom_threshold
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness above which light blooms. 1 is full white on screen, lower values let more of the image bloom.

text.name: bloom_knee_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How gradually bloom fades in below the threshold.

spinner.name: bloom_knee
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How gradually bloom fades in below the threshold.

text.name: bloom_levels_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Blur levels, each twice as wide as the last. More gives a wider, softer bloom.

spinner.name: bloom_levels
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Blur levels, each twice as wide as the last. More gives a wider, softer bloom.

check_box.label: Colour grading
check_box.name: color_grade
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Adjust the colour of the finished image, after tone mapping, like a photo editor.

text.name: color_grade_temperature_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 6500 is neutral. Lower values warm the image toward orange, higher values cool it toward blue.

spinner.name: color_grade_temperature
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 6500 is neutral. Lower values warm the image toward orange, higher values cool it toward blue.

text.name: color_grade_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Positive values shift the image toward green, negative toward magenta.

spinner.name: color_grade_tint
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Positive values shift the image toward green, negative toward magenta.

text.name: color_grade_lift_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Raises the blacks (positive, faded look) or crushes them (negative), without moving white.

spinner.name: color_grade_lift
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Raises the blacks (positive, faded look) or crushes them (negative), without moving white.

text.name: color_grade_gamma_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightens (above 1) or darkens (below 1) the midtones, leaving black and white in place.

spinner.name: color_grade_gamma
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightens (above 1) or darkens (below 1) the midtones, leaving black and white in place.

text.name: color_grade_gain_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scales the image toward white.

spinner.name: color_grade_gain
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scales the image toward white.

text.name: color_grade_contrast_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Contrast around mid grey.

spinner.name: color_grade_contrast
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Contrast around mid grey.

text.name: color_grade_saturation_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 is black and white.

spinner.name: color_grade_saturation
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 is black and white.

text.name: color_grade_vibrance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Saturates muted colours more than ones that are already strong, which keeps skin from going orange. Negative values mute them.

spinner.name: color_grade_vibrance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Saturates muted colours more than ones that are already strong, which keeps skin from going orange. Negative values mute them.

text.name: color_grade_shadow_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the shadows are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

color_swatch.name: color_grade_shadow_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the shadows are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

text.name: color_grade_highlight_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the highlights are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

color_swatch.name: color_grade_highlight_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the highlights are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

text.name: color_grade_split_balance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Moves the line between the shadow and highlight tints. Positive gives the highlight tint more of the image.

spinner.name: color_grade_split_balance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Moves the line between the shadow and highlight tints. Positive gives the highlight tint more of the image.

text.name: color_grade_lut_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. A .cube file, as exported by most grading tools, or a PNG strip (size*size by size pixels, green increasing downward). A full path, or just the file name of one in the luts folder inside your user settings folder. Leave empty for none.

line_editor.name: color_grade_lut
line_editor.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. A .cube file, as exported by most grading tools, or a PNG strip (size*size by size pixels, green increasing downward). A full path, or just the file name of one in the luts folder inside your user settings folder. Leave empty for none.

text.name: color_grade_lut_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the lookup table is applied.

spinner.name: color_grade_lut_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the lookup table is applied.

text.name: chromatic_aberration_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Red and blue fringes that grow toward the edges of the frame, as with a real lens. The value is the fringe width at the corners. 0 is off.

spinner.name: chromatic_aberration
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Red and blue fringes that grow toward the edges of the frame, as with a real lens. The value is the fringe width at the corners. 0 is off.

check_box.label: Only where depth of field blurs
check_box.name: chromatic_aberration_dof
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limit chromatic aberration to out of focus areas, scaled by how blurred they are. Needs depth of field on.

text.name: lens_flare_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Flare, glare and ghosts when the sun or moon is in view and not hidden behind anything. 0 is off.

spinner.name: lens_flare
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Flare, glare and ghosts when the sun or moon is in view and not hidden behind anything. 0 is off.

text.name: film_grain_label

spinner.name: film_grain
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Film grain, strongest in the midtones. 0 is off.

text.name: film_grain_size_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the grain.

spinner.name: film_grain_size
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the grain.

text.name: projector_shadow_softness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Shadows from projector lights get softer the further the object casting them is from the surface. 1 treats the light as the size of its prim, 0 keeps the old sharp edge.

spinner.name: projector_shadow_softness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Shadows from projector lights get softer the further the object casting them is from the surface. 1 treats the light as the size of its prim, 0 keeps the old sharp edge.

text.name: sun_shadow_softness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sun and moon shadows get softer the further the object casting them is from the surface. 1 is the size of the real sun, 0 keeps the old sharp edge.

spinner.name: sun_shadow_softness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sun and moon shadows get softer the further the object casting them is from the surface. 1 is the size of the real sun, 0 keeps the old sharp edge.

text.name: shadow_max_penumbra_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limits how soft a shadow edge can get. Larger values look smoother over long distances but cost more.

spinner.name: shadow_max_penumbra
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limits how soft a shadow edge can get. Larger values look smoother over long distances but cost more.

check_box.label: Show projector shadow test
check_box.name: projector_shadow_debug
check_box.tool_tip: Projectors draw red where shadowed and green where lit instead of light. Blue means the projector has no shadow map.

check_box.label: Hold Alt to grab objects in mouselook
check_box.name: mouselook_alt_drag
check_box.tool_tip: Clicking in mouselook no longer grabs objects unless Alt is held.

check_box.label: Limit turning while seated in mouselook
check_box.name: limit_seated_yaw
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps your view within 90 degrees of the way you sat down.

check_box.label: Preload web windows at login
check_box.name: preload_web_floaters
check_box.tool_tip: Search, Destinations and Marketplace open faster but use more memory. Applies at next login.

check_box.label: Enable the MCP server
check_box.name: mcp_server_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Lets a local AI agent drive your avatar. Any program on this computer can connect while it is on.

text.name: mcp_server_port_label

spinner.name: mcp_server_port
spinner.tool_tip: Local port the MCP server listens on.

check_box.label: Allow chat on any channel through the LSL bridge
check_box.name: mcp_bridge_chat
check_box.tool_tip: The agent can talk to scripted objects and RLV relays. Needs the LSL bridge.

check_box.label: Allow the agent to pay L$
check_box.name: mcp_money
check_box.tool_tip: Payments still respect RLV and the limit below.
